source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 13:1–18 binds Hebrew 13:2–19; chapters 14–18 align directly. Hebrew 13:1 is excluded because the preceding batch binds it to public 12:32. All 134 original XML records, including their written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves both flock and herd rather than narrowing this festival instruction to the animal specification in Exodus 12.
Keeps seven days, bread of affliction, haste, and lifelong remembrance as distinct details; retains full original record with its accent note.
Renders bashal as cook, acknowledging its boiling sense in a note rather than forcing Exodus' roasting language into this clause.
Keeps the six-plus-seventh formulation alongside the earlier seven-day instruction, with the seventh day's assembly and work ban.
Preserves the specifically male appearance requirement alongside the earlier inclusive feast lists, all three names, and the gift requirement.
Preserves the planting/tree wording and the altar's proximity rather than reducing the command to a generic idol ban.
